text: Acceptance 1-2: collection deletes the only durable copy after an import failure. In-memory ui-t16-storage repro: set atalks_storage_v_since to eight days ago, seed legacy B/b1, and make setItem('atalks_unsent_2_5_b1') throw QuotaExceededError. Claim A, restore writes, reload B: [], expected ['b1']. The failed copy is swallowed and its source deleted. Keep the source whenever copying fails.
